answer: On the frozen RES-0137 community-tool snapshot corpus (identical bytes for every lens; fingerprint 03ff85c8c683…), eight candidate gem-hunt lenses were run as phrase-conjunction extractors at mechanism-id granularity. Pre-registered unique-yield threshold=0.10. Seeded self-overlap (document dropout n=2, seeds 17 vs 23) mean Jaccard noise floor=0.860. orchestration-synonym is an exact subset of orchestration (unique_yield=0, Jaccard=0.800) and is MERGE'd into it — the planted near-duplicate control. cost-leverage and bus-fit also have unique_yield=0 versus the union, but their best pairwise Jaccard (0.500) sits below their seed-noise floors, so they are DROP'd rather than merged into one partner. Kept lenses: orchestration, verification, provenance, irreplaceability, failure-mode. Cross-lens Jaccard of verification vs provenance is 0.333, below the mean noise floor, so that shared Merkle finding is indistinguishable from seed noise and is not a merge. SUCCESS:RES-0155.

canonical_mechanism: Pairwise Jaccard of mechanism-id sets across gem-hunt lenses on one frozen corpus, unique-yield merge/drop against a pre-registered 0.10 threshold, gated by seeded self-overlap as the noise floor.

catalog_contract.tests_required_verbatim: negative control: run the SAME lens twice with different seeds and measure its self-overlap - that figure is the noise floor, and any cross-lens overlap below it is indistinguishable from noise

claims.canonical_mechanism: Fan-out overlap measurement: freeze the corpus, vary only the lens extractor, score Jaccard of mechanism-id sets.
claims.strongest_caveat: Extractors are phrase conjunctions, not LLM lenses; they measure whether the declared questions fire on the same documents.
claims.text: Pairwise overlap was computed on mechanism ids extracted from one shared fetched corpus so that lens is the only varying factor.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A planted synonym lens that restates orchestration phrases must collapse rather than count as a second independent viewpoint.
claims.strongest_caveat: The synonym lens was planted. That is a detector control, not a discovery that two independently designed lenses collided.
claims.text: orchestration-synonym unique_yield is 0.0 and its findings are an exact subset of orchestration, so it is MERGE'd into orchestration.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A lens whose canonical findings are already covered by the union of other lenses, without a merge target above the noise floor, is dropped rather than paid for.
claims.strongest_caveat: DROP is corpus-specific. A larger gem-hunt corpus could give cost-leverage a unique rewrite-cost finding and revive it.
claims.text: cost-leverage and bus-fit have unique_yield=0 versus the union of other lenses and no single partner Jaccard clearing their noise floors, so they are DROP'd from the fan-out.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Self-overlap of a lens under seed change is the noise floor; cross-lens overlap below it is indistinguishable from noise.
claims.strongest_caveat: Document-dropout is a mechanical stand-in for LLM sampling seed; it is not a vendor temperature sweep.
claims.text: Running the same lens twice with seeds 17 and 23 (drop 2 documents) sets the self-overlap noise floor; verification vs provenance Jaccard 0.333 is below that floor and is not a merge.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Keep a lens when unique_yield >= 0.10 on the canonical corpus.
claims.strongest_caveat: Kept-set membership is a function of this corpus and the pre-registered 0.10 threshold, not a universal gem-hunt ontology.
claims.text: After merge/drop, the non-redundant fan-out is orchestration, verification, provenance, irreplaceability, and failure-mode.

corpus.note: Every lens reads the same ok=true RES-0137 snapshots. Failed fetches in that index are excluded. Hashes are re-checked on load.

MECH-CWL-WORKFLOW.canonical: CWL v1.2 documents declare cwlVersion: v1.2 on a Workflow class.

MECH-CWLPROV-BAGIT.canonical: CWLProv packages a run as a BagIt object whose primary.cwlprov.provn file is a W3C PROV-N trace.

MECH-GHIDRA-HEADLESS.canonical: Ghidra analyzeHeadless is a batch import/process/script runner with an optional -processor language pin.

MECH-GHIDRA-PASSWORD-ECHO.canonical: analyzeHeadless may echo password text instead of masking it — a documented failure mode of the headless path.

MECH-HTCONDOR-DAGMAN.canonical: HTCondor DAGMan PARENT/CHILD declares success-edges between nodes.

MECH-MO2-USVFS.canonical: USVFS is a User Space Virtual File System that uses API hooking to fool Windows file-access functions.

MECH-NF-CACHE-HIT.canonical: A Nextflow cache hit does not by itself resume the task; outputs must still be recovered from the work directory.
phrases: a cache hit does not guarantee

MECH-NF-RESUME-FRAGILITY.canonical: Resume fails unless both the task cache and the work directory are preserved.

MECH-NF-TASK-HASH-CACHE.canonical: Nextflow stores each executed task in a key-value task cache and recovers it on -resume when the hash hits and work-directory outputs are still present.
phrases: the task cache is a key-value store

MECH-OPENCUE-LAYER-FRAME.canonical: OpenCue substitutes #IFRAME# in a layer command so each frame is one execution.

MECH-SLURM-AFTEROK.canonical: Slurm --dependency=afterok:<jobid> defers start until the predecessor exited successfully.

MECH-SMK-MERKLE-CACHE.canonical: Snakemake hashes a Merkle tree of upstream steps into SNAKEMAKE_OUTPUT_CACHE for reuse between workflows.

MECH-WABBAJACK-REPRO-INSTALL.canonical: Wabbajack reproduces a modding setup on another machine without bundling assets.

MECH-XEDIT-AUTOCLEAN.canonical: xEdit Quick Auto Clean is a game-plugin cleaning tool with no agent-orchestration equivalent.

question: Given the candidate lens set for a wide gem-hunt fan-out, what is the pairwise overlap of the findings each lens produces on one shared corpus, and which lenses can be merged or dropped because their unique yield is below a stated threshold?
